name: Bloodmage: Endure the Curse survives the first hit and heals at 10% health (#599)
contract: Endure the Curse 681190: "Reduce all damage taken by $s2% for $d. While active, taking damage that would reduce your health below 10% will instantly heal you for $681189s1% of your maximum health. Can only occur once." Effect 1 is aura 87 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN, MiscValue 127 (all schools), amount -30, read natively by Unit::SpellDamageBonusTaken. Effect 0 is a SPELL_AURA_SCHOOL_ABSORB over the same mask whose Spell.dbc amount is 0 (BasePoints -1, DieSides 1); with no script Unit::CalcAbsorbResist subtracts the nothing it absorbed and removes the whole aura, effect 1 included, on the first point of damage (Unit.cpp:2515-2523). 681189 is a real SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL_PCT record for 30% of maximum health that nothing in src/, modules/ or data/sql/ referenced. DurationIndex 1 = 10000 ms and RecoveryTime 60000, so the whole run happens inside one cast. Corruption rank 8 (27216) self-applied gives a controlled 150 damage tick every 3 sec; melee combat with the fixture dummy keeps the Bloodmage in combat so no health regeneration runs. The 300 HP fixture is below 10% of maximum health as long as maximum health is above 3000, which is asserted first.
